text:
alex.p: Quick q — planning to take parental leave in June. What's the cutoff to submit paperwork and how do I set up a phased return? cc @sara.hr

sara.hr: Congrats! 🎉 For a June start we ask that you submit the leave request in Workday by May 15 to ensure payroll/top-up transitions go smoothly. We support a 'staggered return' (phased/part-time) for up to 12 weeks after leave. Docs: https://redwood.internal/hr/leave

alex.p: Nice, thanks. Is the 12 weeks separate from the paid parental benefit? Also curious about the childcare stipend and whether I need to enroll separately.

jamie.eng: Also tagging — we can cover on-call but need tentative dates so we can swap. Which weeks are you planning to be out?

alex.p: Tentative dates: Jun 3 - Aug 26. Thinking full leave Jun 3–Aug 12, then phased return (50%) Jun 13–Aug 26 but will confirm. Here's a quick handoff snippet I can paste for the team:

```
Leave: Jun 3 - Aug 26 (approx 12 weeks)
Phased return: 50% first 4 weeks (Mon-Wed remote)
On-call coverage: Jamie + Priya
Handover doc: link to repo
```

alex.p: Also — is there a form for the phased schedule or is manager approval enough?

sara.hr: Paid parental benefit is up to 16 weeks top-up for primary caregivers (company top-up + state/FMLA where applicable). Staggered return is compatible — payroll will pro-rate the top-up during part-time weeks. Childcare stipend: $500/month for first 6 months after return; you must opt in via the benefits portal (Benefits > Family Support).

alex.p: Do I need any extra approvals for the stipend or reduced hours?

karen.pops: Stipend: self-enroll, no separate approval. Reduced hours: manager + People Ops sign-off — we ask for a one-page plan (hours, expected milestones, handover) to keep things clear. Send that to me + your manager and we’ll finalize.

hr-bot: Reminder: Leave request received — ticket #LR-2024-339. Please attach birth certificate or medical certification within 30 days to avoid delays.

sara.hr: I’ll review once you submit. If you want, we can book a 20-min sync this week to run through the handoff and on-call rota. :calendar:

alex.p: Thanks everyone — I just submitted the Workday request and uploaded the tentative handoff doc. Will send the 1-pager to @karen.pops + my manager. Appreciate the help :heart:
